column1: # INV-T-5959. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-650, 661, 664, 691, 710, 711,
# 724, 725 and 1345 (read from Keel), plus the identifiers this task adds. One row per identifier.
# Not listed, because they are not evidence contract identifiers: auditor, security.officer, platform.engineer,
# (entity_id, document_number) (evidence-svc storage indexes, not contract fields).
# lookupByAcknowledgement (INV-REQ-691) and lookupByCounterparty (INV-REQ-710) are Keel names for operations this
# contract publishes as getAcknowledgementChain and reverseLookup; the table names the published ids (owner ruling,
# INV-T-5959 gap 1). categoryCode is a query parameter of reverseLookup (kind query_parameter, INV-Q-6006 A).
# INV-T-6534. Not identifiers of this file, from the published INV-REQ-1304: `tenant.admin` (a role), `setPolicy` (an
# operation of the service-runtime contract), `structuredSubmissions`, `acknowledgementsAndTraces` and
# `sourceDocumentReferences` (properties of the VP-43 value in the catalogue).
# INV-T-6830. The only backticked name of INV-REQ-886 is `console-bff`, a service and no contract identifier; the rows
# below are identifiers this task adds.
# INV-T-6838. INV-REQ-1403 and INV-AC-1404 carry no backticked name; the rows below are identifiers this task adds.

# INV-T-6889. Backticked names of INV-REQ-1109, 1112, 954, 1110 and INV-AC-2107, 2108, 2110, 1046 carried by this contract: importPriorEvidence, importedGaps and the enum members above. Not carried: `evidence-svc` and `submission-svc` (services, no contract identifier), `EXTERNALLY_SUBMITTED` (lifecycle state of the submission contract, carried by the submission match task of INV-Q-6887), `recordMigrationCutover`, `getMigrationCutover` and `migrationCutoverDate` (tenancy contract, INV-T-6238); there is no other.
